notes.title: Cosmic Parkour Discontinuation
notes.content: [h3]Cosmic Parkour is being discontinued[/h3][p][/p][p]Releasing this game to Steam has been quite the underwhelming achievement. I appriciate those who took time to play the game, enjoying the classicness and simplicity of it. [/p][p][/p][p]On the other hand, I also appriciate the criticism that was given on this game, and I've taken it into account when programming my new game. If you like cartoony first person shooters check out my YouTube channel, MicahDaCoder, for news on my new game.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, thanks for the experience, Cosmic Parkour's Steam version will be fully discontinued in 2 weeks, where I will publish one final bug fix and then bid the game goodbye.[/p][p][/p][p]MXGAMES[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][/h1][p][/p][p][/p][p]Edit:[/p][p]Sorry about that guys, I was a bit vague in my announcement. To clarify:[/p][p]Cosmic Parkour is NOT getting removed from Steam anytime soon, unless there are unforeseen circumstances of some sort (very unlikely still).[/p][p]The sale going on right now will either be Cosmic Parkours final sale or its second to final sale, if another sale happens, it will be for the fall sale or Christmas sale.[/p]

Hi guys, Cosmic Parkour gets a bug fix yippie.

[list]
[*] Infinite sliding after performing a walljump glitch should now be fixed.
[*] Game properly pauses when focus is lost.
[*] Summer lobby is turned off and set to the normal one since summer is over.
[/list]

Thanks for playing Cosmic Parkour and I hope you enjoy the updates!
Contact unrealparkourmxgames@gmail.com for questions and concerns.

notes.title: Better Level Keys
notes.content:
What's up sigmas basically today I decided to make level keys better and stuff.

[b]What's new:[/b]

[list]
[*] The level you are playing will display whether you collected the key for it or not. 
[*] Also added level keys to some levels that didn't have any. 
[*] Also, levels that don't have level keys will not ask you to collect them and will only display level timer.
[*] Removed the ingame FPS counter (will br brought back if there is demand)
[/list]

If you have any questions or need support don't hesitate to email at unrealparkourmxgames@gmail.com

Thanks guys, bye now 👋
